questions.subject: Biology
questions.q:
The graphs show the levels of blood glucose in two persons, 1 and 2, before and after ingesting 50 g of glucose.



Which of the statements below is/are CORRECT?
options: The low blood glucose levels in person 1 could be due to renal malfunction.
Insulin levels are likely to be low in person 2.
Glucose will be found in the urine of person 2.
Blood glucose in person 2 could be brought to normal levels by administration of glucagon.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Epinephrine level in blood increases in response to stress. This hormone is known to affect the rate of glycolysis in different organs of the body. The rates of glycolysis in liver, heart and skeletal muscles in response to rise in blood epinephrine (in comparison to non-stress condition) is expected to be
options: unaffected in liver, low in heart, and high in skeletal muscles.
high in liver, low in heart, and low in skeletal muscles.
unaffected in liver, high in heart, and low in skeletal muscles.
low in liver, high in heart, and high in skeletal muscles.
